edit.text: Ward brings Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, to Daniel Whitehall's base, where Whitehall, who decades earlier cut open her mother to steal her youth, threatens to experiment on her. Coulson kills him when the team storms the base to get Skye back.
edit.whoA: The HYDRA leader who cut open Daisy's mother and plans the same for Daisy.
edit.whoB: Daughter of the woman Whitehall cut open. He plans the same experiments on her.

edit.text: Sandman tries to hijack an oil tanker and fights Spider-Man, then saves the tanker's crew and slips away.
In the Master Planner's new Sinister Six, Mysterio attacks Spider-Man with illusions and a robot decoy, until Spider-Man catches the real Beck and he is arrested.
edit.whoA: The hero who sees through Mysterio's decoys and has him arrested.
edit.whoB: A master of illusions Peter finally catches.
edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man

edit.text: Jubilee and Cable's X-Force join the X-Men to stop Gambit, but when Cable tries to kill the unconscious Gambit, she leaves X-Force for the X-Men.

edit.whoB: The agent who hunts Robbie, then teams up with him against Aida.

add.text: Magneto saves Storm and the others when their jet is shot down and joins them against William Stryker at Alkali Lake. He then betrays them, turning Cerebro against humans and flying off in Stryker's helicopter.
add.whoA: An uneasy ally against Stryker, who then betrays the X-Men.
add.whoB: An X-Man who works with Magneto against Stryker, until he betrays them.
add.title: X2

add.text: Thompson turns on Sousa and Peggy Carter, holding them at gunpoint so he can blow up the gamma cannon and kill Whitney Frost, Vernon Masters and Jason Wilkes.
add.whoA: A fellow SSR agent who turns on Sousa at gunpoint over the gamma cannon.
add.whoB: A fellow SSR agent Thompson holds at gunpoint over the gamma cannon.
add.title: Agent Carter S2

add.text: In 1973 Erik tries to kill Raven in Paris, believing her death will stop the Sentinels. Later, in Washington, she brings him down with a plastic gun.
add.whoA: Shot at by Erik in Paris. Stops him in Washington with a plastic gun.
add.whoB: Tries to kill Raven in Paris. She stops him in Washington.
add.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past

edit.text: Tilda poisons her mother Mariah, and when Mariah's will leaves Harlem's Paradise to Luke instead of her, she turns on him.
Renslayer races Mobius and Loki to reach Victor Timely in 1893. When Mobius confronts her, she insists she has always put the TVA above her own happiness.

add.text: Free of Hive, Daisy tries to convince Giyera she is still under his sway as Giyera holds Fitz at gunpoint, but he does not believe her, and Fitz shoots him dead.
add.whoA: Hive's telekinetic follower. Sees through Daisy's bluff before Fitz kills him.
add.whoB: Tries to fool Giyera that Hive still controls her.
